links.outcome: Share of FDA-cleared orthopaedic AI devices lacking clinical testing or validated prospectively
links.effect: 22.8% of 70 devices lacked clinical testing, 68.6% used retrospective data sets, and only 8.6% had a prospective clinical trial. Lack of clinical testing fell from 62.2% (2017-2019) to 19.7% (2022-2024).
links.quote: Overall, 22.8% of orthopaedic AIMDs lacked clinical testing and 68.6% were tested with retrospective data sets.

screen.reason: Retrospective regulatory audit/analysis of 70 FDA-cleared AI/ML-based medical devices in orthopaedic surgery, characterizing their clinical validation status and characteristics.
